title: Spiced Naan Bread
description: A simple recipe for homemade naan bread with a blend of Indian spices.
instructions: Open the naan package and separate the dough into individual pieces.
Roll out each piece of dough into a ball and then flatten it slightly into an oval shape.
Brush the tops of the naans with melted butter or ghee.
Sprinkle the smoked paprika, garlic powder, and cumin powder evenly over the naans.
Place the naans on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the naans are golden brown.
Remove the naans from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
